purpose: Life Simulator biome dropdowns, location validation, settlement culture generation, transit logic, and biome-created factions.
generalBiomeRules: A normal horse stable should not appear under the ocean.
A normal open-air orchard should not appear in a deep cavern.
A heavy foundry should be rare in treetop settlements unless adapted.
A submarine terminal should only appear in ocean, reef, underwater, or hybrid-water settlements.
A skyship port should not replace submarine systems in fully underwater settlements.
A ferry terminal should require water access.
A train station should be common in land settlements.
A capital city should usually include a portal facility unless disabled.

biomes.name: Ocean Surface Floating Settlement
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Farms become floating hydroponic gardens, kelp racks, algae farms, or imported food depots.
Heavy ranches become floating beast pens or aquatic mount pools.
Deep inland locations are replaced with dockside or platform-based versions.

biomes.name: Underwater with Reefs
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Horse Stable becomes Seahorse Stable, Mount Pool, Submarine Dock, or Beast Handling Grotto.
Farm becomes Kelp Farm, Shellfish Farm, Coral Nursery, or Algae Garden.
Tavern becomes Pressure-Sealed Tavern or Air-Dome Inn.
Blacksmith becomes Pressure Forge, Coral Toolmaker, or Salvage Foundry.
Ordinary roads become pressure tunnels, reef corridors, or current routes.

biomes.name: Underwater without Reefs
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Ordinary farms become algae farms, pressure-grown fungus gardens, or imported ration depots.
Open-air markets become pressure markets or submarine cargo exchanges.
Parks become observation domes, abyssal gardens, or preserved bioluminescent groves.

biomes.name: Grassland
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Maritime locations require a river, lake, or hybrid water tag.
Submarine terminals should not appear.
Dense urban districts should be less common unless settlement type is City or Capital City.

biomes.name: Prairie
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Maritime locations require added water access.
Heavy forests should not dominate.
Submarine and reef infrastructure should not appear.

biomes.name: Farming
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Heavy criminal districts should be rare unless danger level is high.
Maritime locations need river, lake, or coastal access.
Skyship ports should be rare unless settlement is large or strategically important.

biomes.name: Mountain Range
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Farms become terrace farms, goat pastures, mushroom farms, or mountain gardens.
Harbors require river, lake, or coastal access.
Large open parks become cliff gardens, stone terraces, or mountain overlooks.

biomes.name: Valley
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Heavy mountain industry should be present only if near cliffs or mines.
Submarine terminals should not appear unless combined with underwater access.
Skyship ports should be moderate, not dominant.

biomes.name: Deep Cavern
favoredLocationTypes: Portal Facility if capital or arcane
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Open-air farms become mushroom farms, cave lichen farms, or glowfruit gardens.
Orchards become fungal groves or glowfruit gardens.
Skyship ports require cavern shafts or surface access.
Parks become crystal gardens, fungus gardens, or underground reserves.
Ranches become cave beast pens or subterranean mount stables.

biomes.name: Deep Forest
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Heavy foundries should be rare or hidden.
Large industrial districts should be replaced with small workshops or concealed craft lodges.
Rail requires forest-cleared routes, elevated rails, or root-safe transit.
Maritime requires river, lake, or swamp access.

biomes.name: Partial Forest
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Heavy industry should be limited unless the economy supports logging, charcoal, or timber craft.
Submarine terminals should not appear.
Maritime requires river, lake, or coastal access.

biomes.name: Treetops - Treehouses
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Heavy foundries become light workshops or suspended craft decks.
Ranches become canopy beast roosts or climbing mount stables.
Ordinary roads become ropeways, bridges, lifts, or canopy paths.
Large warehouses become hanging freight platforms.

biomes.name: Marshes and Swamps
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Farms become rice fields, bog gardens, reed farms, or alchemical herb beds.
Heavy rail requires raised tracks or swamp-stabilized routes.
Large noble estates become stilt manors or hidden marsh villas.
Ordinary roads become boardwalks, ferries, or reed-boat paths.

biomes.name: Beach and Grass with Water
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Deep underwater locations require ocean access.
Heavy cavern locations should not appear unless combined with mountains.
Submarine terminal appears only if deeper water routes exist.

biomes.name: Beach and Reefs with Water
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Farms become shellfish farms, kelp farms, reef gardens, or coastal herb gardens.
Ranches become aquatic mount pools or coastal beast pens.
Blacksmiths may become salvage smiths or coral toolmakers.

biomes.name: Hybrid Tree and Forest Floor
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Heavy industry should be limited to forest floor workshops.
Large warehouses become ground depots or hanging freight platforms.
Ranches become climbing mount stables or forest beast pens.

biomes.name: Hybrid Farming Forest Grassland
reducedOrTransformedLocations: Maritime locations require river, lake, or added water access.
Submarine terminals should not appear.
Heavy industry should be moderate unless supported by settlement size.

multiBiomeSelectionRules.summary: The user may select up to three specific biomes. When multiple biomes are selected, merge their location logic, transformations, faction pools, transit needs, economy, housing styles, hazards, and hooks.

Example: Ocean Surface + Underwater with.description: Creates a layered sea settlement with:

Example: Mountain Range + Deep Cavern.description: Creates a vertical mountain settlement with surface cliffs and underground districts.

Example: Treetops + Deep Forest.description: Creates a forest settlement with canopy and forest-floor layers.
